🎥🎬: Viy: Forbidden Empire (2014)

Cartographer Jonathan Green embarks on a dangerous journey through the unknown lands of Eastern Europe, where he discovers a mysterious village hidden behind a thick fog. As he investigates the strange town, he uncovers dark secrets, ancient legends, and supernatural forces beyond his understanding.

Trapped in a world of curses, monsters, and forbidden magic, Jonathan must survive the terrifying mysteries surrounding the village and its people. His search for truth leads him to confront the legendary creature known as Viy, a powerful force from ancient folklore.
